verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents a self-serve start: open the console Playground, log in, and walk through a first API call with the SDKs. Pricing is also published without any sales contact. However, no quoted docs show account sign-up or API-key creation steps. A community user's mention of 'got access' does not settle whether a waitlist exists. missing for 10: explicit documented sign-up flow, explicit API-key minting/management instructions in docs, independent confirmation that there is no waitlist or approval gate.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign up and mint an API key self-serve — no sales call, no waitlist gymnastics — and the docs say exactly how
